mechanism: Shared latent working memory in KV caches transferred between agents during a single problem
evidence_scope: Across agents, informa- tion is exchanged via shared latent working memory stored in layer-wise KV caches, capturing both the input context and newly generated latent thoughts.
evidence_role: We introduceLatentMAS, anend-to-end training-freeframework that enables pure latent collaboration among LLM agents.
